notes: WordPress REST API, open and unauthenticated: GET https://www.tanea.gr/wp-json/wp/v2/posts with after/before as local 'YYYY-MM-DDT00:00:00' and page=N, per_page=30 (31+ answers WAF 403, so 30 is the hard cap), _fields=id,date,link,content, orderby=date&order=desc; pagination ends on an empty array or HTTP 400 rest_post_invalid_page_number. Walked one local day at a time (31 days, ~7 pages/day) so each day's coverage is guaranteed; a whole-window sweep plus the robots.txt news sitemap (https://www.tanea.gr/wp-content/uploads/json/sitemap-news.xml, only ever ~100 recent posts) are fallbacks if a day comes back thin. Date = the API 'date' field (site-local Europe/Athens), which matches the /YYYY/MM/DD/ permalink and the page's article:published_time within a day (that meta tag is UTC, so posts after 21:00 local show the previous day). Posts whose own content.rendered text is under 700 chars (one-line briefs, video notes, gallery captions, not article pages) are dropped; measured on the lowest surviving band the rendered page still carries 1638+ chars of paragraph text. 225 requests, 305 s, 5788 unique URLs, per-day minimum 126, robots.txt fetched and allowed.
